# <span id="aanchor146"></span> Ticket Type Editor

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">Tickets<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>A measurement of data at a single point in time. A ticket can have a start date and an end date, but FLOWCAL treats it as a single data point.</span></a> can be standalone or they can be assigned to locations where the location represents a measurement point, such a lease automatic custody transfer (LACT), tickets generated while loading/unloading a vessel (ship), or measurement points such as flares or blowdowns.

You will need to define a ticket type when entering a ticket for liquid measurement in the Ticket Editor, Ticket Autofill Editor, or Gas Loss Ticket Editor, or when setting parameters in the Ticket Search screen. FLOWCAL accommodates several [ticket types](Ticket%20Types.md), which are configurable using the Ticket Type Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Ticket Type Editor and modify ticket types:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Ticket Type** within the **Liquids** group.
3.  Select a ticket type and click the **Edit** button.

To create a new ticket type:

1.  Click the **New** button.
2.  Enter the new ticket type name in the **Ticket Type** field.
